title: Tint Unveils The Tint Studio: The Innovation Hub for Embedded Insurance
summary: Tint Unveils The Tint Studio: The Innovation Hub for Embedded Insurance
body_markdown:
**Las Vegas, NV – October 15, 2025 —** At **InsureTech Connect 2025** , **Tint** , the full-stack, AI-powered embedded insurance platform, announced the launch of **The Tint Studio** — a first-of-its-kind innovation hub for embedded insurance.


Embedded insurance represents the future of how consumers interact with and purchase coverage—through the brands they already know and trust. By integrating insurance directly into everyday experiences, it becomes intuitive, relevant, and built around the moments when people actually need it most.


The Tint Studio brings together specialty underwriters, insurers, and digital brand partners to imagine, shape, and launch the next generation of embedded insurance programs. It transforms how innovation happens—turning market insight and specialty expertise into compliant, scalable, and demand-validated programs backed by trusted capacity partners. By combining Tint's embedded infrastructure with the entrepreneurial energy of underwriters and the reach of brand partners, the Studio accelerates innovation from concept to launch, removing the friction that typically slows the industry.


"Tint Studio is where specialized knowledge meets real demand," said **Matheus Riolfi, Co-founder and CEO of Tint** . "We're opening our infrastructure to a broader audience — enabling underwriters with deep domain expertise to connect with insurers who understand their risk, and to design programs that address proven customer needs. It's a collaborative space where good ideas don't just get discussed — they get built, backed, and brought to market."


## Where Innovation Meets Execution


Insurance innovation has always depended on the creativity of specialists — underwriters and MGAs who spot emerging needs and design products to meet them. But the journey from concept to capacity is often hindered by operational hurdles, regulatory complexity, and the challenge of finding the right partners.


Tint Studio bridges that gap. It provides a trusted framework for defining opportunities, validating user demand, sourcing capacity, and building compliant, scalable programs. Underwriters bring their ideas and data; Tint provides the infrastructure — from technology and compliance to operations and partner matching — to make them real. The result is faster launches, stronger partnerships, and programs that are embedded seamlessly into modern digital experiences.


## Discover the Tint Studio at ITC


Meet Tint at InsureTech Connect Las Vegas (Booth #626) for an inside look at how The Tint Studio is helping partners design, test, and launch embedded insurance programs faster than ever.


Tint has proven success in mobility, property management, and transportation and logistics—industries where embedded insurance naturally enhances the customer experience and drives measurable growth. At the same time, the Studio is a collaborative space for innovators across all sectors who see the potential of embedded insurance to make coverage more seamless, data-driven, and connected to real-world behavior.


As part of the ITC agenda, Matheus Riolfi, Co-founder and CEO of Tint, will join Eric Hoelzen, Head of Insurance at Turo, for a Fireside Chat showcasing the success of a live embedded insurance program built through the Studio. Together, they'll explore how starting with distribution and designing for the policyholder inverts the traditional model—delivering stronger adoption, retention, and growth.


Learn more in person at Booth #626 or online at www.tint.ai/tint-studio.


## About Tint


Tint is the full-stack embedded insurance platform that helps leading brands seamlessly turn insurance into a growth engine. By embedding insurance, making it feel like a natural part of the product experience, Tint enables platforms to create new revenue streams while deepening customer trust. Behind the scenes, our infrastructure manages the complexity—program design, regulatory compliance, claims, support—so coverage shows up at just the right moment, without adding friction.


Tint's flexible platform connects with ecosystem partners like GPS providers, payment systems, and telematics tools to build tailored, compliant programs that reflect real-world behavior. These integrations power more data-driven pricing, better loss ratios, and cleaner, more scalable portfolios—giving underwriters and insurers the confidence to back innovative programs, and the visibility to grow them responsibly.


Trusted by forward-thinking companies like **Turo, Deel, Guesty, and uShip** —and backed by **$30M in funding** —Tint makes embedded insurance faster to launch, easier to manage, and better for everyone involved.
